desc:
UPDATE v0.8 (build 162)

NEW HAZARDS
- TORNADO (Easy): giant tornadoes pull, lift and fling your car
- VERITY PARTY (Easy): bouncy Verity balls rain down. Pop them!
- BLOCK DROP (Medium): giant blocks slam down from the sky. Fill a row to clear it!

NEW
- TANK BATTLE: every 3rd race, everyone gets a tank. Shoot the other racers!
- Desert wins now count as 3 WINS!
- Hazard reveal: see this race's 7 hazards before it starts
- Lobby music (Settings > Music)
- New Energy Blast robot animations
- What's New card when you join

FAIRER
- Rocket Turrets: hits don't stop you dead, more warning
- Police are solid for everyone and take turns
- Stuck cars get put back on the road automatically

MOBILE
- Smaller HUD, results no longer cover your car
- Tank Battle: tap to fire

FIXES
- Hazards on slow phones no longer miss shots
- Stats saving fix
- Removed broken models
